podcast.body: Released in 1996, this album became one of the most important in UK history. Its success contributed to a significant shift in the recording market, leading major labels to redirect their commercial efforts towards bands like the Spice Girls. "en CMM 1996 apareció una de los discos más importantes de la historia del reino unido, nos gustó, que fue el disco de las Spiesgates."

podcast.body: The debut CD of the Spice Girls, initially released in 1996 in the UK and globally, was released in the US in winter 1997. It topped the Billboard 200 album chart in America and became the year's top-selling disc, selling 5 million copies. "Spice Girls debut CD, Spice topped the Billboard 200 album chart and wound up the year's top selling disc, selling 5 million copies."
